task.name: Assemble_EMT_shade
task.when: During Build after placement approves the camp footprint

resources.resource: Build Lead and the crew count printed in 📦 Build_Book
Work gloves, eye protection, and closed-toe shoes

step.action: Confirm the current EMT-shade drawing, parts manifest, crew count, lift sequence, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
step.ifThen: IF any information is missing or the physical parts differ, THEN do not start.

step.action: Mark the exact footprint and orientation from 📦 Camp_Map.
Confirm that emergency exits and service lanes remain clear.
Count every tube, fitting, fastener, covering, strap, brace, and anchor against the manifest.
Inspect each counted component for bending, cracking, cuts, fraying, or missing hardware.
step.ifThen: IF a component is damaged or missing, THEN separate it and tell the Build Lead.

step.action: Lay out the roof components in the numbered orientation shown in the drawing.
Assemble each roof bay in the printed sequence.
Secure each roof connection using the hardware and specification in the drawing.
Attach the roof covering at the stage specified in the drawing.
step.ifThen: IF wind catches the covering or prevents clear commands, THEN lower or secure the work, stop, and wait for acceptable conditions.

step.action: Raise each section only on the Build Lead's command.
Install each leg in the printed sequence.
Secure each raised section immediately with its temporary or final support.
Install every anchor, chain, brace, and ratchet strap shown in the drawing.
Tension the covering evenly to the final-state photograph.
Have the Build Lead compare every connection and anchor with the drawing.

passWhen.criterion: The completed shade matches the current drawing and final-state photograph.
Every listed connection, fastener, brace, strap, and anchor is installed.
No damaged component, loose covering, sharp edge, or unmarked trip hazard remains.
Emergency exits and service lanes are clear.
The Build Lead completed the final inspection.

reasoning.entry: The workbook gives only EMT Build calendar entries, so the actual geometry, counts, anchor layout, and crew sequence must be supplied by the camp-specific Build Book.
Burning Man warns that 75 mph winds are common; raising and covering remain Build Lead-controlled operations.
